comment: Metric catalogue. 'browser.<id>' inherits the spec of '<id>' unless listed explicitly. gate = stats compared against the baseline; report = extra stats shown but never gated. slack = absolute change below which a regression is ignored (default by unit). pct = relative threshold override (default 5). noiseWidening=false disables max(5%, 2*CV) widening. budgets: absolute limits (value must be < max); a breach fails only if the baseline met it.

vault.openToTree.desc: Open Vault Folder click to root tree rows painted

vault.searchIndexReady.desc: open click to needle query returning 1 result

tree.expandBigFolder.desc: expand the 500-drawing folder to rows painted

search.keystroke.desc: per keystroke, input to results painted

budgets.why: DECISIONS: search p95 < 50 ms on a 5,000-drawing vault

open.large.desc: No absolute budget by decision: the large drawing embeds ~18 MB of images, so only the 5% regression gate applies.

search.keystrokeJs.desc: per keystroke, JS cost of the input event (dispatch to return, no frame wait)

typing.keystrokeJs.desc: per character in the WYSIWYG editor, JS cost of the input event (dispatch to return)

pan.longFrames.desc: frames > 50 ms; no new long tasks: median must not exceed baseline

typing.longFrames.desc: frames > 50 ms; no new long tasks: median must not exceed baseline

typing.keystroke.desc: per character typed, input to next frame

idle.cpuPercent.desc: CPU of app + WebKit helpers over the idle window, % of one core

memory.peakRssMB.desc: peak sum of RSS (app + WebKit helpers); overcounts shared/framework pages, see memory.peakFootprintMB

memory.peakFootprintMB.desc: sum of lifetime phys_footprint_peak over app + WebKit helpers (Activity Monitor basis), read at idle-end

budgets.why: DECISIONS: peak memory < 400 MB with a large vault

memory.idleFootprintMB.desc: sum of current phys_footprint over app + WebKit helpers at idle-end
